What is a vinyl wrap?

Coloured vinyl over your original paint. A brand new colour, *protected* paint underneath, and it *peels* *off* *clean* whenever you want.

0%Reversible. Your factory paint stays untouched underneath.
0finishesGloss, satin and matte. Full or partial.
0daysRoughly what a full colour change takes, finished by hand.

Good
questions

A quality cast vinyl wrap usually lasts several years. Sun exposure, the finish you choose and how you care for it all play a part.

Not on healthy factory paint. The wrap protects it. Resprayed or damaged paint can lift on removal, so we inspect the car first.

Vinyl changes the look. PPF is a thicker, mostly clear film built to absorb chips and scratches. Plenty of cars get both.

Yes. Roofs, mirrors, bonnets, stripes and chrome delete are all popular partial jobs.

Hand wash with a pH-neutral shampoo, keep high pressure off the edges and skip abrasive polish. We'll go through it all at handover.
